interiors.name: Press passage
interiors.role: 4 m clear vaulted passage from Laundry to Press porch; ordinary reverse route.

interiors.name: Customs porch
interiors.role: L-shaped roofed connection from B court to S6 receiving stepside.

interiors.name: School arcade
interiors.role: 4 m clear arcade joins the north bridgehead to the Bell ascent side.

interiors.name: Taverna receiving room
interiors.role: Bridge entry, shallow return, then Fountain or School departure. Roof remains occupied building mass above.

interiors.name: Inn archway
interiors.role: Straight civic arch; useful through-support retained, unlike the middle gateway.

obstacles.name: Cistern rim
obstacles.role: Crouch preparation north of A; open flanks remain. Does not secure bridge stance.

obstacles.name: Boat handling bench
obstacles.role: Ground-level crouch reset toward S5; elevated S5/S6 can look behind it. Not universal site cover.

obstacles.name: Taverna internal return
obstacles.role: Separates the bridge-facing stance from east/north exits; 5.55 m clear path south of tip.
